critical_code_review_comments: routes_teams.routing_rebalance — algorithm is O(2000) safe: donors filtered on `unworked.get(k)` truthy so exhausted busiest is dropped next iteration; break condition `busiest-quietest<=1` bounds moves; loop cap 2000 caps a pathological run. No infinite loop risk.
routes_teams.routing_rebalance — only moves status=='New', opportunity_id absent, and created_at >= month_start. Matches PRD ('surplus unworked, not converted, this-month'). Good.

routes_teams.routing_rebalance — logs event via log_event with reason 'Rebalanced from <A> to <B>' and updates lead.routing_reason with 'Rebalanced — moved from <name> to even out load' (as spec'd). Two distinct strings — intentional (audit vs UI) but could be unified to reduce drift.
routes_teams.routing_balance — 'max' includes prev-month counts (`max(counts + [r['prev'] for r in reps])`) so the bars scale to both series consistently — nice touch for the two-tier bar UI.
routes_teams.routing_balance — `spread = max(counts)-min(counts)` computed only over `counts` (this-month) — correct; prev is display-only and doesn't affect the rebalance target.

routes_voice._configured() — correctly gates on all 5 vars including TWIML_APP_SID + VOICE_FROM. GET /voice/config + /voice/token both return {enabled:false} without exposing secrets. Auth is required (ANY_CRM = lead_manager/account_manager/staff). Good.

routes_voice.py — webhooks /twiml and /status are include_in_schema=False and unauthenticated (correct — Twilio signs them), and no-op safely if _configured() is false. Note: production should add TwilioRequestValidator on X-Twilio-Signature to avoid webhook spoofing when the feature is enabled. Not blocking now (voice is off).
Softphone.js — clean disabled state, ARIA/testID set. Race guard on enabled===null (renders null) prevents flash of disabled block during config load.
Teams.js — scope toggle triggers re-fetch via useCallback+scope dep; rebalance calls load() so bars refresh. Toast copy differentiates 0 (Already balanced) vs N moved. UX is tight.
